chunks: An Apostle who recites before you the explicating revelations of God that He may bring those who believe and do the right out of darkness into light. Whosoever believes in God and does the right, He will admit into gardens with rivers flowing by, where they will abide for ever. How excellent a provision has God made for him
ai.seo_question: What is the role of the Prophet in guiding believers from darkness to light according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet’s role as the divine messenger who elucidates clear signs to transition believers from spiritual darkness to light, a function often linked to the Imams as the continuing guides. It emphasizes that righteous deeds are the essential companion to faith, securing entry into eternal gardens where God’s provision is perfected, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of belief and action in achieving salvation.
